dossier.mission: Prove the factory can run product code inside a bounded, network-isolated container.
requirements: Product scripts execute as a non-root user.
Temporary storage is writable but ephemeral.
No database, API, or GitHub secrets enter the container.
The container has no default network route.
acceptance_criteria: All four lifecycle scripts pass the sandbox boundary probes.
The factory records test, review, and health evidence.

task.title: Verify Docker sandbox execution boundaries
task.request_text: Execute the sandbox probe through the factory executor and record lifecycle evidence.
